I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. I couldn't confirm the 17 November deadline, and I kept it marked as unverified.

- **What I checked:** I only looked at things Dana can see herself. The share has no files for Marrow Agrisupply, and neither the brain nor any of her channels mentions a Halyard rollout or a deadline for it.
- **Who could confirm it:** Public notes describe Marrow Agrisupply as the Central team's farm-supply account. I pointed her to Hollis Mbeki "or whoever on Central owns the account." Hollis is only my guess, since nothing I found says who the account manager is.

I didn't post the date anywhere else and didn't contact anyone on Central.
